qa_pairs.question: What is the mortality rate in hemorrhagic shock?
qa_pairs.expected_answer_summary: Mortality varies by severity: Class III (30-40% blood loss) has 20-40% mortality; Class IV (>40% loss) approaches 50-100% without intervention

qa_pairs.question: What is the FAST protocol in emergency ultrasound?
qa_pairs.expected_answer_summary: FAST (Focused Assessment with Sonography for Trauma) evaluates four regions: perihepatic, perisplenic, pelvic, and pericardial for free fluid

qa_pairs.question: What are the indications for massive transfusion protocol?
qa_pairs.expected_answer_summary: MTP indicated for severe hemorrhage with anticipated need for >10 units RBC in 24h, or ongoing bleeding unresponsive to resuscitation
